fields.failure_reason: The run did not complete as pre-registered: run 2 was stopped from outside after two of three pairs, and D48's same-seed re-run could not reproduce h088 exactly, because the reference state is rebuilt with Aer on every run and differs between calls by up to 3e-16 on h088 and h268 (audit). fields.result: Untestable by D48: the re-run did not reproduce h088 exactly (logL differences up to 1.4e-4; null 99th percentile 14.37 vs 14.57), so h268 is untestable. The re-run's own reading, reported and not scored: the blur-type term still needed on all three pairs with readout error up to 3x calibration (LR_b 59.7, 111.0, 34.5; p 0.001 at B 1,000; h088's label rests on a null its counts reject).
fields.scoring_note: Not scored: untestable by D48 (written before the re-run, 2452d3e), whose exact-reproduction check failed on h088; audited (dfc26bf): verdict stands. Rule 15: a re-analysis of 3 November's tomography counts (witness-run-1.json) with no new data; ng-p3-5 is the first scored bet on that run, so secondary_of is set and the row would stay out of the primary Brier even if Sean overrode the audit. Engine 0.55 and Sean's 0.30 stay attached, unscored.
fields.novelty_line: partly new. In SPAM tomography a "blame gauge" trades loss of state purity for detector noise with no change in the counts (Lin et al. 2021, arXiv:1910.07511; Jayakumar et al. 2024, arXiv:2308.15648), and standard state tomography fixes it only by assuming the measurement is known (Jackson & van Enk 2015, arXiv:1508.05633); on a transmon, Aasen et al. (2024, arXiv:2312.04211) report that mitigated tomography does less well when T1/T2 are effectively shortened, and suggest that state-dependent errors are the cause. No paper found tests whether per-qubit readout error bounded at 3× in-job calibration can stand in for an incoherent term. This bet's re-run, which is untestable by D48 and not scored, says no on the three pairs of one 3 November ibm_fez job; with the wide bounds (knob up to +0.05) its point LR falls within the null on two (h221, h268), as the gauge implies. Search: WebSearch plus arXiv abstract/API and HTML full-text pages, 2026-11-05, terms "gate set tomography gauge freedom SPAM", "blame gauge state preparation measurement", "simultaneous tomography quantum states SPAM noise", "readout error mitigated state tomography T1 T2", "assignment matrix conflates state preparation readout error IBM", "noise model selection likelihood ratio IBM tomography", "ibm_fez Heron two-qubit tomography readout dephasing". Written by a fresh session (claude-opus-5-5) that did not run the bet; it classifies the re-run's unscored reading.
